name: Siminn hf.
summary: Síminn hf., a telecommunication company, provides communication solutions in Iceland and internationally. The company operates through seven segments: Mobile, Fixed Voice, Internet and Network, TV, IT Services, Equipment Sales, and Others. It offers mobile services; fixed voice services; data services, including xDSL service, GPON, internet, IP net, core network, local loop, and access network; TV broadcast and distribution services; and hosting, advisory, telecommunication, and operation services, as well as sells IT related hardware and telecommunication equipment. The company also sells products online. Síminn hf. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Reykjavík, Iceland.
